description.en: The ID of the region where the gateway is located.
The number of entries per page.

description.zh:
列出全部告警事件或正在告警中的事件。
- 当取值为**alerting**时，表示列出正在告警中的事件。
- 当取值为空时，表示列出全部告警事件。
description.en:
The status of the alert events.

- If you set this parameter to **alerting**, only the events that are being triggered are listed.

- If you do not specify this parameter, all alert events are listed.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sgw list-alert-events --gateway-id gw-000eg44nmxbsfwbvq000 --share-index-id nfs_share --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --first-trigger-timestamp-start-time 1761559501337 --first-trigger-timestamp-end-time 1761570323090 --gateway-region-id cn-shanghai --status alerting --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sgw ListAlertEvents --region cn-hangzhou --Status alerting --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --FirstTriggerTimestampStartTime 1761559501337 --GatewayRegionId 'cn-shanghai' --GatewayId 'gw-000eg44nmxbsfwbvq000' --ShareIndexId nfs_share --FirstTriggerTimestampEndTime 1761570323090
